lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadee aarajaa har gobi(n)d kee sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: van trin tribhavan hariaa hoe sagale jee saadhaariaa ||
lines.translation: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhe naanak phal paae pooran ichh pujaariaa ||2||5||23||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled. ||2||5||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis oopar hovat daiaal ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simarat kaatai so kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhajeeai gopaal ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat tootai jam jaal ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape satigur aape pratipaal ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal ||2||6||24||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi si(n)chahu har har naam ||
lines.translation: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin keeratan har gun gaam ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee preet karahu man mere ||
lines.translation: Enshrine such love, O my mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh jaanahu nere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke niramal bhaag ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag ||2||7||25||
lines.translation: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: rog gaiaa prabh aap gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: need paee sukh sahaj ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raj raj bhojan khaavahu mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rid maahi dhiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur poore saranaaee ||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: jin apane naam kee paij rakhaaee ||2||8||26||
lines.translation: who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kar deene asathir ghar baar || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo ni(n)d karai in grihan kee tis aagai hee maarai karataar ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa ko sabad akha(n)d apaar ||2||9||27||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable and infinite. ||2||9||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: taap sa(n)taap sagale gae binase te rog ||
lines.translation: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham too bakhasiaa sa(n)tan ras bhog || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa teree ma(n)dalee teraa man tan aarog ||
lines.translation: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahu nit raam ke ih avakhad jog ||1||
lines.translation: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potent medicine. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai basahu ghar des mahi ih bhale sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed and auspicious occasion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhae lahi gae biog ||2||10||28||
lines.translation: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end. ||2||10||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo sa(n)g na chaalahee maaiaa ja(n)jaal ||
lines.translation: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooth sidhaare chhatrapat sa(n)tan kai khiaal || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh kau binasanaa ih dhur kee dhaal ||
lines.translation: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bahu jonee janamahi marahi bikhiaa bikaraal ||1||
lines.translation: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo kahahi nit japahi gupaal ||
lines.translation: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak tare har ke ra(n)g laal ||2||11||29||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with the color of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh ana(n)d sookh poore gur deen ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sa(n)g prabh a(n)mrit gun cheen || rahaau ||
lines.translation: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues. ||Pause||
